rv.q: It is difficult to imagine a more poetic encapsulation of the at-all-costs mentality of not just this particular wannabe landowner, but of all people and nations willing to shed blood to claim property for themselves.
Fortunately, Murphy’s dynamic, muscular choreography and the solid story he tells so inventively through both his staging and its arresting visuals prove to be positive takeaways.
a gripping true-crime drama, pulsing through exhilarating dance-theater with kinetic, electrifying force
Scorched Earth has its slow spots, but the visual and physical poetry of its ending ensures that the last impression is breathtaking.
